correctness.rationale: Geometric-sum homogeneous formula and monotonicity in failure rate give the exact one-dimensional boundary minimization. Localization to \(a_t\asymp(\log t)/t\) yields a uniform \(o(t^{-1})\) approximation and the +1 constant. Bellman disk support gives an exact positive deficit recursion with reciprocal increments tending \(r/2\). All boundary cases, radius restrictions and limits were independently reconstructed; verify.py confirms finite arithmetic, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: For a motivated robust-reachability problem where the eventual upper probability is one without homogeneous attainment, this exact disk geometry quantifies an unbounded \((\log t)/4\) finite-horizon price of committing to a single transition matrix. Full leading constants and explicit feedback actions provide interpretable calibration and a sharp small-state boundary, not an arbitrary enumeration or a renaming of a textbook claim.
